newsitem.title: USA: La. sweet crudes retreat, refiners play Apr expiry.
newsitem.headline: La. sweet crudes retreat, refiners play Apr expiry.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices chopped widely Wednesday on maneuvering ahead of the April crude futures expiration Thursday, leaving grade differentials whipsawed after a strong start for the Louisiana sweets.
April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing talked late at steady to five cents lower, putting the benchmark value at $21.95-$22.05 per barrel.

Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James rocketed out of the gate to gain 15 cts, selling actively at WTI/Cushing plus 12 and 15 cts, but the bubble burst soon thereafter and eventually deals were confirmed later in the session at negative values.
